name: Earth Shield
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pebble or pinch of dirt)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell wreathes you in hard, rocky earth that increases your natural armor by 4. The earthen armor also renders you immune to unarmed/nonlethal and normal ranged attacks (siege weapon attacks affect you normally, but must penetrate a hardness of 15 first). Your base speed is reduced by 10 ft. for the duration of the spell (minimum 5 ft./round), but you suffer no Dexterity penalty or spell failure chance.
